messages:
maria: Heads-up — quick async for the v2 sunset runway. Need an owner rollup + any blockers before EOD Fri. cc @kevin @anna @devin @shay

kevin: I'm primary for SDK toggles. Active PRs: #4821 (python), #4823 (typescript). Python PR is blocked by compat tests failing on CI.

anna: Routing owner here. Did a quick smoke on staging this morning — saw a brief 503 spike when fallback routing kicked in (around 11:12). Logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T11:12:23Z router WARN fallback engaged for req a1b2c3
2026-03-17T11:12:23Z upstream ERROR connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T11:12:24Z router INFO routed to fallback-variant
```

devin: Infra note: that looks like conn-pool exhaustion, not app bug. Bumped pool on the canary: `CONN_POOL=200` and the spike didn't recur. Will roll that change to the staging canary tonight once runtime patch lands.

shay: Comms question — can we hold the sunset announcement until legal signs off on the customer-facing copy? @sam-legal

sam-legal: Confirmed — please remove the example usage that shows token consumption per request. I can do a quick copy edit, ping me when the draft's updated.

kevin: SDK toggle plan sketch: we'll use a feature flag `enable_v2_deprecation` exposed in SDKs. Example client change (py):
```python
client = Redwood(api_key=..., feature_flags={"enable_v2_deprecation": True})
```
I'll add the toggle docs to each SDK repo and gate the default to `false` until canary looks good.

release-bot: deploy done: staging-canary @ 1796000120 by devin :white_check_mark:

maria: Owner list for clarity: kevin (SDK toggles), anna (routing/fallbacks), devin (infra/conn-pool), shay (comms). Please update the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/runways/v2-sunset (add your PR links).

anna: :thumbsup: I'll add a note about TTLs and header propagation tests. ETA for config PR: tomorrow EOD.

devin: Heads-up — we need eng-runtime's socket manager patch before we fully roll the pool bump to prod (prevents excessive open sockets). @jordana from eng-runtime?

jordana: I'm on that runtime patch. Merged to staging branch this morning, prepping a minor release cut tomorrow.

kevin: CI flakiness: `test-embed-header` is failing intermittently on py CI. @maria can you file a short bug so I can block the py SDK PR until green?

maria: Filed INF-1127 and linked it in both PRs.

shay: Comms draft uploaded: https://docs.google.com/draft/v2-sunset-draft — scheduled for Friday 09:00 PT pending legal signoff.

sam-legal: Reviewed and approved with one tiny edit (removed token usage example).

maria: Final checklist before announcement: 
1) runtime minor release cut (jordana)
2) infra pool bump (devin)
3) SDK toggles merged + canary (kevin)
4) legal signoff (sam-legal)
5) announcement email scheduled (shay)
Any other blockers?

anna: One blocker on my side: need an integration test proving header fallback for our edge proxy (ticket ENG-3345).

kevin: I'll author that integration test today and link the PR. Will hold py SDK PR until we see infra prod bump scheduled.

devin: Tentatively scheduling prod pool bump for Fri 01:00 UTC. I'll confirm by EOD.

release-bot: scheduled prod bump: 1796003600 (deferred job created)

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If no new blockers, I'll do a final readout in tomorrow's standup and mark the rollout doc ready. :rocket:
